message.content: {"question":"Let R₃[x] be the vector space of polynomials in the variable x, of degree less or equal than 3 and with coefficients in ℝ. Which one of the following subsets of R₃[x] is a vector subspace?","options":{"A":"The set {p(x) = ax³ + bx² + cx + d ∈ R₃[x] : a + b = 0}.","B":"The set {p(x) = ax³ + bx² + cx + d ∈ R₃[x] : ad - bc = 0}.","C":"The set {p(x) = ax³ + bx² + cx + d ∈ R₃[x] : a + b + c + d = 1}.","D":"The set {p(x) = ax³ + bx² + cx + d ∈ R₃[x] : ac = 0}."},"correct":"A"}
